description: Every land bank's public inventory in one CLI. ePropertyPlus is a SaaS land-management platform many US land banks run on; this CLI talks to its public JSON API, parameterized by instance (slug). Enumerate a land bank's published properties, hydrate full per-property detail (parcel geometry, zoning, potential use, condition custom fields), filter structures vs vacant lots, export to CSV/GeoJSON, and resolve/download listing images. No auth required.

tools.name: property_get
tools.description: Returns the full property record (parcel number, address, geometry, zoning, potential use, structure type, occupancy, asking price, image thumbnail, and custom condition fields) under the returnVal envelope. Required: propertyId.

tools.name: property_get-custom-field-configs
tools.description: Returns the instance's custom-field configuration so the cryptic s_custom_*/n_custom_* keys on a Property can be mapped to human-readable names (e.g. condition flags). Note: the upstream wraps the JSON in a 'var customFieldConfigs = JSON.parse(...)' assignment.

tools.name: property_get-image
tools.description: Returns the binary image. The imageId and filename come from a Property's publicThumbImgUrl (path shape /property/viewImage/{imageId}/{filename}). Required: imageId, filename.

tools.name: property_list-properties
tools.description: Returns the full set of published public properties as lightweight index rows (id, latitude, longitude, status, class code). This is the enumeration entry point; hydrate each id with getPublishedProperty for full detail.
